# Conflict Rule 6 ## Go easy on new players
[italic][color=yellow]New players have a learner plate over their head, "They are new around here." when examined, and [bold](L)[/bold] after their ship's name on radar and hails.[/color][/italic]
- [color=red][bold]Do not frag newbies.[/bold][/color] No killing, spacing, stranding or round-removing a tagged player over low-level conflict. -- Round-removing means gibbing, borging, selling them or refusing to clone them. -- Arrest, fine, rob or disable them instead, then let them go.
- [bold]Newbie ships are not for sinking.[/bold] You can hail, board, rob or disable a ship tagged [bold](L)[/bold]. You can't destroy it or kill its crew unless they fight back. -- [textlink="Demands and piracy" link="MonolithRuleConflictThreeFairPlay"] still apply on top of this.
- [bold]No big handouts.[/bold] Don't give a newbie more than [color=yellow][bold]20,000 spesos[/bold][/color] in cash or gear per round. -- No gifting ships, top-tier weapons or contraband.
- [bold]Don't bait newbies.[/bold] No tricking them into breaking rules or wrecking things, no teaching them wrong as a joke, no telling them a rule isn't real.
- [bold]Don't use newbies as disposable crew.[/bold] You can recruit them into crime, but don't send them on suicide jobs or leave them to take the blame.
- [bold]Don't scam newbies.[/bold] No lopsided trades for their ship, deed or savings.
- [bold]The tag is OOC.[/bold] Don't bring it up in character, and don't pick a target because of it. That falls under [textlink="metagaming" link="MonolithRuleRoleplaySixMetagame"].
- [bold]Leniency, not immunity.[/bold] A newbie who starts the violence loses this protection for that fight. Admins will explain the rules to them before punishing.
- [bold]No tag, no protection.[/bold] Players can hide their tag in Options > Extra. An untagged player is treated like anyone else.
